evidence.title: Rotating Arc Grid - Book of Shapes

name: Book of Shapes
summary: Collection of minimal generative SVG patterns you can customize and download, free including commercial use.
description: A curated gallery of algorithmic SVG patterns — grids, flow fields, truchet arcs, isometric cubes and more — each with parameters to adjust and an SVG to download. Free for any use, commercial included; the only limit is that the patterns may not be redistributed as patterns.
contains: generative SVG patterns: grids, flow fields, truchet arcs, isometric cubes, halftone
each pattern is customizable and downloadable as SVG
patterns carry tags (grid, flow, isometric, distortion) and link to related patterns
free for any use including commercial, no attribution required
one limit: patterns may not be redistributed as pattern packs or generators
